rationale: All 10 algebraic identities from the paper's Sections I-II reproduce exactly (Hamiltonian form to 4e-16, Fano antiresonance, Curie 1/|t| law, soliton charges, optical edge ratio). The approximate resonance/soft-mode formulas correctly converge to their criticality limits. However, this is a proceedings paper with no numerical tables—agreement is necessarily on functional forms and order-of-magnitude claims only. Key physics (quantum breather spectrum, microscopic mass renormalization, temperature laws) are mentioned but given no closed forms, capping coverage. The replication is mechanism-level complete for what the paper actually specifies analytically.
